exposure: Optimization and standardization of antibiotic use for early- and late-onset sepsis
outcome: Proportion of neonates receiving any antibiotics
cohort: The study included 2,098 neonates in the pre-ASP period (2014-2015) and 5,464 neonates in the post-ASP period (2016-2019) admitted to a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The neonatologist-driven antimicrobial stewardship program was associated with a 64.8% reduction in antibiotic use (DOT per 1,000 patient-days) without any change in mortality, culture-positive microbial profile, or multidrug-resistant organism incidence.
